reviews.title: Not intuitive enough, too much mass deletion
reviews.text:
I thought there were a lot more features and this would be easy to use based on reviews but this only does 3 things and it’s not clear at all what you’re mass selecting and mass deleting. I didn’t feel like I had enough control or understanding of how to use this. Needs clear instructions. 

At one point I had both live and still photos in Photos because I chose the wrong option (and I had to manually delete those myself in Photos, they weren’t appearing in the Similar category), my next try it deleted all still photos that were made (I guess I chose the option to cancel what it had done) then finally I figured out how to get it to delete the Live Photos and keep still. 

Another problem is it increases the space taken up on your phone, the opposite of what the goal is, with all the duplication mistakes that had to be put in the Recently deleted folder. I definitely accidentally permanently deleted some Live Photos that I had wanted to keep in all this confusion. I have 5,000+ Live Photos and was close to my iPhone storage max so at least it never got through them all. 

At another point I was trying to get rid of Live Photos one by one because I realized there are some I want to keep that way and not just mass delete/convert them but somehow even though I was checking each one off I wanted it started mass creating stills from all live instead of what I chose, so I had to undo that (I.e. put all those in Recently Deleted and increase space used on my phone). reviews.title: This app used to be perfect, but now it’s like every other AI cleanup app.
reviews.text:
I used to absolutely adore this app. But when I reinstalled this time, the app that I downloaded had changed significantly from the one that I had before. The only thing my app has is the Storage page: Quick clean, swipe clean and compress. 
The fact that this app was unpaid but didn’t hit you with a barrage of ads mid workflow or behind a paywall made it unique to begin with, but what made it second to none was the features that came in the unpaid package. 
Similars (versus just duplicates allowing you to pick which similars to keep and which it thought were the best)
Heavies (for really large photos/video files which usually is a mistake of not switching back to standard def format)
Maybe these are now behind in-app purchases but I haven’t found a spot where you can even choose to get them back. It’s all just so very disappointing and here I am writing what may just be my first written review in at least 15, but maybe all of my time on the Apple Store.

reviews.title: Very disappointed with Version 3.0
reviews.text:
After updating to Version 3.0, Clever Cleaner has become extremely slow, and I can no longer manage to delete my photos properly.

Before the update, I could manually select the photos I wanted to delete. Now, photos are automatically selected and moved to the delete folder, which I really don’t like.

I much preferred the old version. Please bring back the previous photo selection and deletion experience!

reviews.title: Badly Needs to Show Accurate Video Sizes
reviews.text: Clever Cleaner shows video sizes much larger than their actual size. I compress my own videos to save space, yet from what I can tell, Clever Cleaner is reading the original much larger video size and showing it as not compressed. To prove this, once a larger sized file shows, it’s compressed file is located, size of video file is 10 times smaller, then I let Clever Cleaner Delete the videos, and it has deleted the smaller already compressed files. I have yet to test original uncompressed video by Clever Cleaner as if it did compress the file as much as I wanted, I would still be in the same situation, unless it’s own compressor routine actually updated file size to actual smaller size, then “Heavies” would no longer be found by a scan. Still Clever Cleaner app needs to read accurate video file size, not the older original file size. After this “bug” is eliminated, I can delete this review. I have a Degree in Computer Engineering and I’m one of two nationwide, original Chomps app reviewers before Apple came out with their review system.

reviews.title: totally free but totally dumb
reviews.text: this app is like all the ads of those cleaning apps with the swipe and the heavy video thing but the problem is this app actually takes a decent amount of storage up like 1-2 gb but when my storage is almost full it doesnt let me open the app it says “there is not enough storage on your phone to run clever cleaner” SO WHAT DO YOU WANT ME TO DO!!! yes i could delete a few apps to free up some space to open it but im so sick and tired of deleting apps for quick storage and then just running out of storage right after and i go to free more storage quickly and then the app is like nah your storage problem is too big im not tryna deal with this. but yea i guess its alright aside from that so 2 stars.

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: I downloaded this app after searching on Google how to easily compress my live photos into stills in bulk. Although I can appreciate that the app is free with no ads or subscriptions, it does not work. At first I tried compressing all of my live photos  (around 2,700), waited for each one to be converted, “deleted” them once the process was complete but the photos were not deleted. I then uninstalled and reinstalled the app, tried compressing smaller groups of photos but this did not help. I then tried moving “deleted” item to the trash bin to then manually delete them, but the “swipe to delete” button did not do anything either. Frustrating as I’d love an easy way to convert all of my live photos to save space rather than having to do this individually.

reviews.title: Broken

I swipe swipe swipe and it doesn’t delete so I can’t trash anything what’s frustrating, I’ve deleted the app and reinstalled and it works for a bit then it happens again, soft reset my phone, nothing fixes this bug. App has so much potential but untill swipe feature lets you actually delete pictures it’s pointless.
